title: Yeasty Velvety Thai Chicken Curry
description: A comforting and flavorful Thai chicken curry made with yeasty notes and velvety texture, featuring castelvetrano olives and cooked in a clay pot, perfect for a sick day, this low calorie friendly dish is a must try
instructions: Preheat the clay pot over medium heat and add the yeast extract to melt and mix with the curry paste.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the castelvetrano olives, fish sauce, and brown sugar to the pot and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season the curry with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
